text.feels_intro: How {name}'s wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a light bruise or scratch.
{name}'s face: a nasty, bleeding wound, swollen and discolored. A faint smell of blood clings to {him}.
{name}'s face: a severe injury, bleeding heavily and badly swollen. {name} smells strongly of blood.
body: {name}'s back: a light bruise or scratch.
{name}'s back: a nasty, bleeding wound, stiff and discolored. The smell of blood clings to {his} clothing.
{name}'s back: a severe injury, bleeding heavily; {he} can barely stay upright. {name} smells heavily of blood and sweat.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a nasty, bleeding wound, swollen and sore. It smells faintly of blood.
{name}'s {part}: a severe injury; the arm is badly hurt and almost useless. It smells strongly of blood.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a nasty, bleeding wound, swollen and sore. It smells faintly of blood.
{name}'s {part}: a severe injury; the leg barely takes weight. The smell of blood rises from it.

head: {name}'s face stings and aches a little. {name} is a bit shaken.
{name}'s face throbs and aches. {name} is hurting and angry.
{name}'s face is agony. {name} is dazed, frightened and barely coherent.
body: {name}'s back aches a little. {name} is stiff and tense.
{name}'s back throbs with each breath. {name} moves stiffly, wincing.
{name}'s back is agony. {name} is gasping and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} aches a little and is tender. {name} protects it.
{name}'s {part} throbs and is weak. {name} cradles it.
{name}'s {part} is agony and barely works. {name} is in shock and holds it still.
leg: {name}'s {part} aches a little. {name} walks with a slight limp.
{name}'s {part} throbs with every step. {name} limps and winces.
{name}'s {part} is agony and will not take weight. {name} falls or needs support.

levels: , a sudden stab of pain. It catches {him} by surprise and {he} flinches and grunts.
on a spot that is already sore. The pain flares, and {he} cries out.
, and it lands hard on the wound. The pain is huge and nauseating, and {he} staggers. The smell of blood rises.
, and it is too much. The pain crashes through {him}; {he} goes pale and {his} legs begin to give.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

head: the blow breaks {his} skull; blood pours from {his} nose, mouth and ears and runs from the hollow where an eye was. {name} drops limp, a last gasp rattling out of {him}, and the iron smell of blood spreads over the ground.

{his} face and head are smashed open, a ruin of broken bone, torn skin and blood, with something grey showing in the wound. {name} crumples without a word, and the warm smell of blood and brains hangs in the air.
body: the blow tears into {his} back and chest, breaking ribs and bursting what lies beneath; blood gushes from {his} mouth and soaks {his} clothes. {name} falls choking, a last red bubble at {his} lips, in the thick smell of blood.

the wound rips {his} body open; torn flesh, broken bone and dark blood spill out together, and a sour smell of opened gut and half-eaten food mixes with the iron of blood. {name} sags to the ground with a long, final moan.
arm: {his} {part} is torn and broken past saving, bone through the skin and blood pouring from the ruin. {name} collapses, pale and shaking, and bleeds out with {his} final cries, the air thick with the smell of blood.
{his} {part} is mangled into a bloody, twisted wreck of bone and muscle hanging by strips of skin. {name} screams, then falls silent, dying in a spreading pool that smells of blood and sweat.
leg: {his} {part} is broken and torn open, splintered bone jutting from the flesh and blood soaking the ground. {name} falls and does not rise; as {he} bleeds out, the smell of {his} blood fills the air along with {his} last cries.
{his} {part} is ripped and shattered, bent the wrong way beneath {him}, blood pumping from the wound. {name}'s screams fade into ragged breaths and then silence in the iron reek of blood.

soil: As {his} body goes slack, the stink of {his} shit and piss mixes with the blood.
In death {his} bowels and bladder let go, and the stench of shit and piss joins the smell of blood.
